title: Seattle’s First Downtown, Reimagined
abstract: Pioneer Square, which was settled in 1852 and fell into decline after World War II, is now home to artists, designers and inventive restaurants.

title: In Berkeley’s Warehouses, Foodies Find a New Home
abstract: Long a D.I.Y. answer to San Francisco’s Design District, West Berkeley is now attracting innovative culinary entrepreneurs looking to spread their wings.

title: A Town on New York’s Hudson River Reinvents Itself
abstract: Stylish restaurants, quirky boutiques and a craft brewery are helping Troy, population 50,000, to mount a comeback.
